Implemented the IGES CLI under [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) with supporting modules in [output/igeslib](/workspace/output/igeslib/__init__.py) and an executable wrapper at [output/iges](/workspace/output/iges). It supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, writes fixed-format 80-column IGES, emits diagnostic JSON on failures, parses the canonical global and directory structures, and includes schema-driven handling for the shipped IGES entity catalog plus evaluation for the required parametric curve/surface families.

I verified that the code compiles with `python -m py_compile` and smoke-tested `write -> parse -> eval -> roundtrip` on a synthetic Type 110 line entity, including a byte-identical roundtrip on the generated file.
